title: Divergent mechanistic reliance on the phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase (PI4K)/oxysterol-binding protein (OSBP) axis during Zika virus versus dengue virus and West Nile virus replication organelle biogenesis.
abstract: Positive-strand RNA viruses remodel host endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membranes into replication organelles (ROs) that support genome replication. Members of the genus Orthoflavivirus exploit host lipid pathways, particularly the phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase (PI4K)-phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate (PI4P)-oxysterol-binding protein (OSBP) axis, yet they display marked mechanistic divergence. Specifically, it raised a central and unresolved question: is local PI4P enrichment an indispensable determining factor for viral vesicle biogenesis, or is it merely a contributing factor to a more fundamental, underlying mechanical requirement for high membrane curvature? Zika virus (ZIKV) shows strong dependence on PI4P enrichment. ZIKV nonstructural protein 1 (NS1) binds negatively charged lipids, including PI4P, via a positively charged membrane-binding surface that includes Arg31. This interaction supports NS1-mediated ER remodeling and subsequent OSBP-mediated cholesterol delivery. In contrast, dengue virus (DENV) and West Nile virus (WNV) largely bypass strict PI4P dependence. Their RO biogenesis relies more heavily on viral membrane proteins (NS4A/NS4B), host reticulon RTN3.1A, alternative lipid-shape remodeling (including phospholipase A2-generated lysophosphatidylcholine in WNV, sterol availability, and fatty-acid synthesis. Beyond the PI4P-OSBP axis, virus-specific exploitation of lipid peroxidation (ALOX12 pathway), cholesteryl-ester-enriched lipid droplets (via SOAT1/SOAT2), nuclear lipid droplets, and glycerophospholipid/ceramide remodeling further differentiates these viruses. These distinctions have direct implications for host-targeted antivirals. PI4K and OSBP inhibitors show preferential activity against ZIKV, whereas SOAT1/2 inhibition exhibits broader anti-orthoflaviviral potential, and other targets (FASN, NAAA, ALOX12) display virus-weighted efficacy. Recognition of this mechanistic spectrum is essential for accurate interpretation of lipid-perturbation studies and for the rational design of broad-spectrum or virus-selective antiviral strategies.

title_zh: 寨卡病毒与登革病毒及西尼罗病毒在复制细胞器生物发生过程中对磷脂酰肌醇4-激酶(PI4K)/氧化固醇结合蛋白(OSBP)轴依赖机制的差异
source_body_en: Positive-strand RNA viruses remodel host endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membranes into replication organelles (ROs) that support genome replication. Members of the genus Orthoflavivirus exploit host lipid pathways, particularly the phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase (PI4K)-phosphatidylinositol 4-phosphate (PI4P)-oxysterol-binding protein (OSBP) axis, yet they display marked mechanistic divergence. Specifically, it raised a central and unresolved question: is local PI4P enrichment an indispensable determining factor for viral vesicle biogenesis, or is it merely a contributing factor to a more fundamental, underlying mechanical requirement for high membrane curvature? Zika virus (ZIKV) shows strong dependence on PI4P enrichment. ZIKV nonstructural protein 1 (NS1) binds negatively charged lipids, including PI4P, via a positively charged membrane-binding surface that includes Arg31. This interaction supports NS1-mediated ER remodeling and subsequent OSBP-mediated cholesterol delivery. In contrast, dengue virus (DENV) and West Nile virus (WNV) largely bypass strict PI4P dependence. Their RO biogenesis relies more heavily on viral membrane proteins (NS4A/NS4B), host reticulon RTN3.1A, alternative lipid-shape remodeling (including phospholipase A2-generated lysophosphatidylcholine in WNV, sterol availability, and fatty-acid synthesis. Beyond the PI4P-OSBP axis, virus-specific exploitation of lipid peroxidation (ALOX12 pathway), cholesteryl-ester-enriched lipid droplets (via SOAT1/SOAT2), nuclear lipid droplets, and glycerophospholipid/ceramide remodeling further differentiates these viruses. These distinctions have direct implications for host-targeted antivirals. PI4K and OSBP inhibitors show preferential activity against ZIKV, whereas SOAT1/2 inhibition exhibits broader anti-orthoflaviviral potential, and other targets (FASN, NAAA, ALOX12) display virus-weighted efficacy. Recognition of this mechanistic spectrum is essential for accurate interpretation of lipid-perturbation studies and for the rational design of broad-spectrum or virus-selective antiviral strategies.
abstract_zh: 正链RNA病毒通过重塑宿主内质网(ER)膜形成复制细胞器(ROs),以支持基因组的复制。该属的病毒利用宿主脂质通路,特别是磷脂酰肌醇4-激酶(PI4K)-磷脂酰肌醇4-磷酸(PI4P)-氧化固醇结合蛋白(OSBP)轴,但它们在机制上表现出显著的差异。具体而言,这提出了一个核心且未解决的问题:局部PI4P富集是否是病毒囊泡生物发生不可或缺的决定因素,还是仅仅是一个促进因素,用于满足更基础、更根本的高膜曲率机械需求?寨卡病毒(ZIKV)对PI4P富集表现出强烈的依赖性。ZIKV非结构蛋白1(NS1)通过包含Arg31的正电荷膜结合表面与带负电荷的脂质(包括PI4P)相互作用,这种相互作用支持NS1介导的内质网重塑以及随后OSBP介导的胆固醇输送。相比之下,登革病毒(DENV)和西尼罗病毒(WNV)则主要绕过了严格的PI4P依赖。它们的RO生物发生更依赖于病毒膜蛋白(NS4A/NS4B)、宿主的网状蛋白RTN3.1A,以及替代的脂质形态重塑(包括WNV中由磷脂酶A2生成的溶血磷脂酰胆碱、固醇可用性以及脂肪酸合成)。除了PI4P-OSBP轴之外,病毒特异性地利用脂质过氧化(ALOX12通路)、富含胆固醇酯的脂滴(通过SOAT1/SOAT2)、核脂滴以及甘油磷脂/鞘脂重塑,进一步区分了这些病毒。这些差异对针对宿主的抗病毒药物具有直接的临床意义。PI4K和OSBP抑制剂对ZIKV表现出选择性活性,而SOAT1/2抑制则展现出更广泛的抗正黄病毒潜力,其他靶点(FASN、NAAA、ALOX12)则显示出针对不同病毒的疗效。认识到这种机制谱系对于准确解读脂质扰动研究以及合理设计广谱或病毒特异性抗病毒药物策略至关重要。

title: Dengue Vaccines: Bridging Innovation and Public Health
abstract: Dengue is among the fastest-growing mosquito-borne viral infections worldwide and continues to pose a major public health challenge because no approved antiviral treatment is available. As a result, vaccination has become a cornerstone of dengue prevention. Several vaccine candidates have progressed through clinical development; however, questions remain regarding their efficacy, long-term safety, and ability to provide consistent protection against all four dengue virus serotypes. Over the last five years, findings from phase II and phase III clinical trials, post-licensure safety monitoring, and real-world effectiveness studies have substantially advanced the understanding of vaccine performance and influenced both regulatory recommendations and future vaccine development strategies. Despite these advances, important immunological issues remain unresolved, including the induction of balanced and durable immunity against all serotypes, identification of reliable correlates of protection, and clarification of how age and pre-existing dengue immunity affect vaccine responses. Clinical studies have reported variable outcomes, with several vaccines offering moderate protection against symptomatic dengue while showing differences in efficacy among serotypes and lower effectiveness in individuals without prior dengue exposure. Consequently, vaccination policies have evolved toward more targeted approaches, including pre-vaccination serological testing in selected settings, preferential use among seropositive populations, and integration of immunization programs with vector control and disease surveillance measures. Current research is focused on developing next-generation vaccines that provide stronger tetravalent immune responses, longer-lasting protection, and improved safety for seronegative individuals. In parallel, innovative clinical trial methodologies and detailed immunological analyses are being employed to better define the mechanisms underlying protective immunity. This review summarizes recent clinical evidence, emerging immunological knowledge, and evolving public health policies to provide an updated assessment of dengue vaccines and to identify key research priorities for achieving safe, effective, and equitable dengue prevention through vaccination. Keywords: Immunity; Dengue-vaccine; Tetravalent; Antibody-dependent enhancement; Serostatus-dependent efficacy; Vaccine-effectiveness; Pre-vaccination screening

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on dengue vaccines, examining their development, efficacy, and public health implications. Dengue, caused by four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4), remains a significant global health challenge due to the lack of approved antiviral treatments. The review highlights the progress made in vaccine development through phase II and III trials, post-licensure monitoring, and real-world effectiveness studies. However, key unresolved issues include the induction of balanced immunity against all serotypes, identification of correlates of protection, and the impact of age and prior immunity on vaccine responses. The review also discusses the evolution of vaccination policies toward targeted strategies, such as pre-vaccination serological testing and integration with vector control. Research priorities include improving tetravalent immune responses, enhancing safety for seronegative individuals, and refining trial methodologies to better understand protective mechanisms.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 登革热是全球增长最快的蚊媒病毒感染之一,由于目前尚无批准的 抗病毒药物 治疗,它继续对公共卫生构成重大挑战。登革病毒 1–4 和登革热疾病;其他黄病毒是近邻排除项。生物学相关的动物、分类学、模型、差异 诊断 以及比较实体是补充性的,除非存在针对特定目标的实质性证据;只有明确的词汇或无关的硬排除项才是最终的。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 多个 疫苗 候选疫苗已进入临床开发阶段;然而,关于其有效性、长期安全性以及能否对所有四种 登革病毒 血清型提供一致保护的问题仍然存在。在过去五年中,来自 II 期和 III 期临床试验、上市后安全性监测以及真实世界有效性研究的发现,显著推动了对 疫苗 性能的理解,并影响了监管建议和未来 疫苗 开发策略。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 临床研究报告了不同的结果,一些 疫苗 对有症状的登革热提供了中等程度的保护,但其在不同血清型之间的有效性存在差异,并且在无既往登革热暴露的个体中效果较低。尽管取得了这些进展,一些重要的免疫学问题仍未解决,包括诱导对所有血清型的平衡且持久的免疫、识别可靠的保护相关指标,以及阐明年龄和既往登革热免疫如何影响 疫苗 的免疫应答。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 当前的研究重点是开发下一代 疫苗,以提供更强的四价 免疫应答、更持久的保护以及对血清阴性个体更安全的疫苗。同时,创新的临床试验方法和详细的免疫学分析正在被采用,以更好地定义保护性免疫的机制。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 因此,疫苗接种 政策已向更具针对性的方法演变,包括在特定环境中进行 疫苗接种 接种前的血清学检测、在血清阳性人群中优先使用,以及将免疫接种计划与 媒介 控制和疾病 监测 措施相结合。本综述总结了最近的临床证据、新兴的免疫学知识以及不断演变的公共卫生政策,以提供登革热 疫苗 的最新评估,并确定实现通过 疫苗接种 实现安全、有效和公平的登革热预防的关键研究优先事项。

title: Early warning of serotype replacement, spatial risk redistribution, and shifting clinical phenotypes: Insights from the 2023-2025 dengue outbreak in Meta, Colombia.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue remains a major public health challenge in hyperendemic regions, where shifts in serotype circulation, spatial transmission patterns, and clinical presentation can significantly influence outbreak dynamics. Colombia has experienced intense dengue activity in recent years; however, integrated analyses combining virological, spatial, and clinical data remain limited. METHODS: A retrospective longitudinal observational study was conducted using routinely collected dengue surveillance data from the Department of Meta, Colombia, covering the period from January 2023 to September 2025. Confirmed dengue cases with viral isolation and serotype identification were included. Temporal trends, serotype replacement dynamics, municipal-level spatial redistribution patterns, and clinical characteristics were analyzed using laboratory-confirmed dengue cases. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to identify factors associated with dengue positivity overall and by serotype, while interannual variation was assessed to evaluate changes in transmission intensity and the spatial redistribution of dengue transmission risk. RESULTS: Marked serotype replacement was observed during the study period. DENV-2 predominated during the 2023 peak, followed by a decline and a sustained increase in DENV-3 and DENV-4 by 2025, while DENV-1 disappeared from recent records. Spatial analysis showed declining diagnostic positivity in historically hyperendemic municipalities and significant interannual increases in intermediate municipalities, indicating an epidemiological rebound outside major urban centers. Classical dengue symptoms, including headache, myalgia, and rash, were inversely associated with virological confirmation, whereas nonspecific neurological manifestations, such as somnolence and irritability, emerged as independent predictors. Severe thrombocytopenia remained strongly associated with infection, particularly in DENV-2 cases. CONCLUSIONS: The dengue outbreak in Meta (2023-2025) was characterized by dynamic serotype replacement, spatial redistribution of transmission risk, and changing clinical presentations. The rapid emergence of DENV-4 in 2025 serves as an early warning of serotype replacement and underscores the need to update clinical screening protocols to include nonspecific neurological manifestations. Strengthening decentralized laboratory networks and closing surveillance gaps in low-endemicity areas are strategic priorities to improve early detection and outbreak control in hyperendemic regions.

analysis_zh.main_results: 在研究期间观察到显著的血清型替代现象。2023年高峰期DENV-2占主导地位,随后到2025年DENV-3和DENV-4出现下降并持续上升,而DENV-1则从近期记录中消失。空间分析显示,在历史上高度流行的市镇中诊断阳性率下降,而在中间市镇中年度间显著上升,表明在主要城市中心之外出现了流行病学反弹。经典登革热症状,如头痛、肌肉痛和皮疹,与病毒学确认呈负相关,而非特异性神经症状,如嗜睡和易激惹,成为独立预测因素。严重的血小板减少症仍与感染密切相关,尤其是在DENV-2病例中。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: Meta地区2023-2025年的登革病毒暴发表现出动态的血清型替代、传播风险的空间重新分布以及临床表现的变化。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 加强分散式实验室网络并在低流行地区填补监测缺口是提高高度流行地区早期检测和暴发控制的战略优先事项。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告具体的研究设计局限性。

title: Computational Insights Into the Conformational Dynamics of the Dengue Virus Capsid Protein
abstract: ABSTRACT The Dengue virus (DENV) capsid protein plays an important role in the viral lifecycle, including encapsidation of the genome, recruitment of lipid droplets, and assembly of particles. Capsid protein includes a hydrophobic pocket, which plays a central role in these functions and switches between closed and open conformations. This work studies the conformational change pathway of the capsid protein, specifically how the molecular mechanisms controlling the opening and closing of the hydrophobic pocket are controlled. By using a combination of different types of molecular dynamics simulations and enhanced sampling methods, we share insights on the structural rearrangements that play a crucial role in governing these transitions. Our results show that lipid binding modulates the accessibility of the hydrophobic pocket through environmental cues. In the open conformation, the pocket is involved in the interaction with lipids, stabilization of capsid dimers, and the promotion of immature virus assembly. Conversely, the closed conformation protects the hydrophobic pocket from the surrounding aqueous media as also preventing premature interactions in the solution phase that might disrupt protein stability. Such insights allow a deep understanding of capsid protein's conformational dynamics and represent a promising set of potent targets for antiviral strategies aiming to interfere with its functional transitions.

abstract_zh: 摘要 登革病毒(登革病毒)衣壳蛋白在病毒生命周期中起着重要作用,包括封装基因组、招募脂滴以及颗粒组装。衣壳蛋白包含一个疏水性口袋,该口袋在这些功能中起核心作用,并在闭合和开放构象之间切换。本研究探讨了衣壳蛋白的构象变化路径,特别是控制其疏水性口袋开闭的分子机制。通过结合不同类型分子动力学模拟和增强采样方法,我们分享了关于在调控这些转变中起关键作用的结构重排的见解。研究结果表明,脂质结合通过环境信号调节疏水性口袋的可接近性。在开放构象中,该口袋参与与脂质的相互作用、衣壳二聚体的稳定以及未成熟病毒的组装。相反,闭合构象保护疏水性口袋免受周围水性环境的影响,并防止溶液相中可能破坏蛋白质稳定性的过早相互作用。这些见解有助于深入理解衣壳蛋白的构象动态,并代表了针对抗病毒药物策略干扰其功能转变的有前景的潜在靶点。

title: Assessment of the persistence and recovery of dengue virus RNA in urban wastewater: implications for Wastewater-Based Epidemiology.
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) poses a growing global public health threat due to increasingly frequent and severe outbreaks. Moreover, epidemiological surveillance systems have limitations in the timely detection of outbreaks, highlighting the need for complementary tools such as Wastewater-Based Epidemiology (WBE). This study aimed to generate further information on the persistence and recovery of DENV RNA in urban wastewater to support its monitoring through WBE. Two experiments were conducted. In Experiment 1, the persistence of DENV RNA in urban wastewater incubated at 4, 25, and 35°C for 21 days was evaluated. A negative binomial mixed-effects regression model estimated temperature-specific decay coefficients of -0.67 (95 % confidence interval (CI): -0.74--0.59), -1.25 (95 % CI: -1.32--1.17), and -1.31 (95 % CI: -1.37--1.23) at 4, 25, and 35°C, respectively. The corresponding times required for a 90 % reduction in genomic copies concentration were 30.1 (95 % CI: 20.7-48.1), 5.3 (95 % CI: 4.7-6.1), and 4.8 (95 % CI: 4.3-5.4) days. In Experiment 2, the performance of four recovery methods was compared. Ultrafiltration showed the highest recovery efficacy (61 ± 8 %), followed by direct analysis (42 ± 10 %) and polyethylene glycol precipitation (7 ± 4 %). Skimmed milk flocculation yielded results below the limit of detection. In conclusion, DENV RNA persisted in urban wastewater for several days at environmentally relevant temperatures, and ultrafiltration achieved the highest recovery efficacy among the methods evaluated, supporting the application of WBE as a community surveillance tool for DENV.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the persistence and recovery of dengue virus (DENV) RNA in urban wastewater, aiming to support its use in Wastewater-Based Epidemiology (WBE). Two experiments were conducted: one assessed RNA persistence at different temperatures, while the other compared recovery methods. Results showed that DENV RNA persisted for several days at environmentally relevant temperatures, with ultrafiltration demonstrating the highest recovery efficacy. The authors concluded that these findings support the application of WBE as a surveillance tool for DENV. However, the study's evidence is limited to controlled conditions and does not account for real-world variability in wastewater composition. The implications of the study suggest that WBE could enhance outbreak detection and inform public health strategies, but further research is needed to validate these findings in diverse settings.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus (DENV) poses a growing global public health threat due to increasingly frequent and severe outbreaks. Moreover, epidemiological surveillance systems have limitations in the timely detection of outbreaks, highlighting the need for complementary tools such as Wastewater-Based Epidemiology (WBE).
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This study aimed to generate further information on the persistence and recovery of DENV RNA in urban wastewater to support its monitoring through WBE. Two experiments were conducted.
analysis_en.methods: A negative binomial mixed-effects regression model estimated temperature-specific decay coefficients of -0.67 (95 % confidence interval (CI): -0.74--0.59), -1.25 (95 % CI: -1.32--1.17), and -1.31 (95 % CI: -1.37--1.23) at 4, 25, and 35°C, respectively. The performance of four recovery methods was compared.
analysis_en.main_results: Ultrafiltration showed the highest recovery efficacy (61 ± 8 %), followed by direct analysis (42 ± 10 %) and polyethylene glycol precipitation (7 ± 4 %). Skimmed milk flocculation yielded results below the limit of detection.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: DENV RNA persisted in urban wastewater for several days at environmentally relevant temperatures, and ultrafiltration achieved the highest recovery efficacy among the methods evaluated, supporting the application of WBE as a community surveillance tool for DENV.

title_zh: 对登革病毒 RNA在城市污水中持续性和恢复性的评估:对基于污水的流行病学的启示。
source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV) poses a growing global public health threat due to increasingly frequent and severe outbreaks. Moreover, epidemiological surveillance systems have limitations in the timely detection of outbreaks, highlighting the need for complementary tools such as Wastewater-Based Epidemiology (WBE). This study aimed to generate further information on the persistence and recovery of DENV RNA in urban wastewater to support its monitoring through WBE. Two experiments were conducted. In Experiment 1, the persistence of DENV RNA in urban wastewater incubated at 4, 25, and 35°C for 21 days was evaluated. A negative binomial mixed-effects regression model estimated temperature-specific decay coefficients of -0.67 (95 % confidence interval (CI): -0.74--0.59), -1.25 (95 % CI: -1.32--1.17), and -1.31 (95 % CI: -1.37--1.23) at 4, 25, and 35°C, respectively. The corresponding times required for a 90 % reduction in genomic copies concentration were 30.1 (95 % CI: 20.7-48.1), 5.3 (95 % CI: 4.7-6.1), and 4.8 (95 % CI: 4.3-5.4) days. In Experiment 2, the performance of four recovery methods was compared. Ultrafiltration showed the highest recovery efficacy (61 ± 8 %), followed by direct analysis (42 ± 10 %) and polyethylene glycol precipitation (7 ± 4 %). Skimmed milk flocculation yielded results below the limit of detection. In conclusion, DENV RNA persisted in urban wastewater for several days at environmentally relevant temperatures, and ultrafiltration achieved the highest recovery efficacy among the methods evaluated, supporting the application of WBE as a community surveillance tool for DENV.

title: Changes in Dengue Epidemiology in China Before, During, and After COVID-19 2015-2024: A Retrospective National Surveillance and Spatiotemporal Study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue remains a major mosquito-borne disease in China. The COVID-19 pandemic and associated non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) profoundly altered human mobility and public health responses, potentially reshaping dengue transmission dynamics. However, comprehensive nationwide evidence on their long-term epidemiological impact is limited. OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate changes in dengue epidemiology in China before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic, with a focus on temporal periodicity, importation and indigenous transmission, counterfactual deviations from pre-pandemic trends, and spatial risk redistribution. METHODS: We conducted a nationwide retrospective spatiotemporal study using reported dengue cases in China from 2015 to 2024. Epidemiological characteristics were compared across pre-pandemic, pandemic, and post-pandemic phases. Morlet wavelet analysis was used to assess temporal periodicity. A SARIMA model fitted to pre-pandemic data generated counterfactual forecasts for 2020-2024. Spatial patterns were evaluated using provincial incidence mapping, Global Moran's I, and Local Indicators of Spatial Association. RESULTS: A total of 87 182 dengue cases were reported, with major peaks in 2019 and 2024. Imported cases declined sharply during 2020-2022 and rebounded after 2023, whereas indigenous transmission became increasingly dominant. Annual periodicity weakened during the pandemic but re-emerged after 2023. Observed incidence during 2020-2022 was frequently below counterfactual expectations, while substantial positive deviations appeared from mid-2023 and intensified in 2024. Post-pandemic dengue risk re-emerged in South and Southwest China and expanded inland, with weaker provincial clustering. CONCLUSIONS: COVID-19 and related NPIs substantially reshaped dengue epidemiology in China, suppressing transmission during 2020-2022 but followed by a marked post-pandemic resurgence, increasing indigenous transmission, disrupted but re-emerging seasonality, and broader inland spread.

However, comprehensive nationwide evidence on their long-term epidemiological impact is limited. Objective This study aimed to evaluate changes in dengue epidemiology in China before, during, and after the COVID-19 pandemic, with a focus on temporal periodicity, importation and indigenous transmission, counterfactual deviations from pre-pandemic trends, and spatial risk redistribution. Methods We conducted a nationwide retrospective spatiotemporal study using reported dengue cases in China from 2015 to 2024. Epidemiological characteristics were compared across pre-pandemic, pandemic, and post-pandemic phases. Morlet wavelet analysis was used to assess temporal periodicity. A SARIMA model fitted to pre-pandemic data generated counterfactual forecasts for 2020-2024. Spatial patterns were evaluated using provincial incidence mapping, Global Moran's I, and Local Indicators of Spatial Association. Results A total of 87 182 dengue cases were reported, with major peaks in 2019 and 2024. Imported cases declined sharply during 2020-2022 and rebounded after 2023, whereas indigenous transmission became increasingly dominant. Annual periodicity weakened during the pandemic but re-emerged after 2023. Observed incidence during 2020-2022 was frequently below counterfactual expectations, while substantial positive deviations appeared from mid-2023 and intensified in 2024. Post-pandemic dengue risk re-emerged in South and Southwest China and expanded inland, with weaker provincial clustering. Conclusions COVID-19 and related NPIs substantially reshaped dengue epidemiology in China, suppressing transmission during 2020-2022 but followed by a marked post-pandemic resurgence, increasing indigenous transmission, disrupted but re-emerging seasonality, and broader inland spread.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines changes in dengue epidemiology in China from 2015 to 2024, focusing on the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and associated interventions. It reveals a sharp decline in imported cases and a rise in indigenous transmission during the pandemic, followed by a resurgence post-pandemic. The study uses a spatiotemporal approach, including Morlet wavelet analysis and SARIMA modeling, to assess trends and deviations. While the evidence is moderate due to reliance on reported data, the results provide important insights into how pandemic-related measures have influenced dengue transmission patterns.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热仍然是中国主要的蚊媒传染病。然而,关于其长期流行病学影响的全国性证据仍有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们使用2015年至2024年中国报告的登革热病例,开展了一项全国范围的回顾性时空研究。比较了疫情前、疫情期间和疫情后各阶段的流行病学特征。
elements_zh.methods: 采用Morlet小波分析评估时间周期性。基于疫情前数据拟合的SARIMA模型生成了2020-2024年的反事实预测。通过省级发病率地图、全球Moran's I指数和局部空间关联指标评估空间模式。
elements_zh.main_results: 共报告了87,182例登革热病例,主要高峰出现在2019年和2024年。2020年至2022年期间输入病例显著下降,但在2023年后反弹,而本土传播则变得越来越主导。疫情期间年度周期性减弱,但在2023年后重新出现。2020年至2022年期间观察到的发病率经常低于反事实预期,而从2023年中期开始出现显著的正向偏离,并在2024年加剧。疫情后,登革热风险重新出现在中国南方和西南地区,并向内陆扩展,省级聚集性减弱。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: COVID-19 and related NPIs substantially reshaped dengue epidemiology in China, suppressing transmission during 2020-2022 but followed by a marked post-pandemic resurgence, increasing indigenous transmission, disrupted but re-emerging seasonality, and broader inland spread.
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以谨慎地用于指导中国登革热的监测策略、风险评估和公共卫生干预措施,强调需要采取适应性措施以应对疫情后不断变化的传播动态。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖于报告的登革热病例,可能存在漏报或监测实践变化的问题。证据强度中等,因为其基于观察性数据和反事实建模。

title: Vector Traits Shape Disease Persistence: A Predator–Prey Approach to Dengue
abstract: Dengue continues to pose a major global threat, infecting nearly 390 million people annually. Recognizing the importance of studying vector biology and therein vector competence ( v c ), recent research focuses on mosquito parameters to inform transmission modeling and vector control strategies. This study models relationship between Aedes vectors and dengue pathogens, highlighting v c as a key driver of within-vector infection dynamics and endemic persistence. Using a predator-prey framework, we show that endemic conditions emerge naturally from the biological interplay between vector's strategies and pethogen pressure. We prove global stability of such conditions and determine thresholds of v c for three types of functional responses ( v c q ∗ , q = 0 , 1 , 2 ). Our results reveal that under tropical and subtropical environmental pressures, the innate immune system of vectors cannot offset high v c during endemic outbreaks, highlighting a fundamental biological trade-off: vectors can evolve increased transmission potential but cannot enhance immune capacity. This constraint defines the limits of their evolutionary response to pathogen-driven selection and drives instability in disease transmission dynamics.

title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

abstract_zh: 蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV))构成了日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前针对这些感染的特异性抗病毒药物疗法尚不普及。这种未满足的医疗需求凸显了从生物相关来源(如植物来源的天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用基于生物活性的筛选方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行分析,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中DENV-2的感染。五种提取物显著降低了病毒的感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。随后的分级和纯化过程分离出四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷,其结构通过超高效液相色谱-二极管阵列检测-质谱(UPLC-DAD-MS)和一维/二维核磁共振(1D/2D NMR)光谱进行表征。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制DENV复制,表现为病毒RNA水平、NS1和NS3蛋白表达以及传染性病毒滴度的显著下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,这与抑制病毒复制和/或蛋白质加工一致。分子对接分析支持这些发现,预测这些化合物与关键病毒酶(特别是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶)具有有利的相互作用。重要的是,分离出的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV也表现出抗病毒药物活性,表明其具有跨虫媒病毒的疗效。综上所述,这些发现表明螺甾烷皂苷是具有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。

title: Optimising malaria and dengue case management through optimal diagnostic test allocation under budget constraints.
abstract: In 2023 Burkina Faso faced hyperendemic Plasmodium falciparum malaria alongside the largest dengue epidemic recorded in West Africa. Both present as undifferentiated fever, and rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) are the practical means of distinguishing them at the point of care. We formulate a 15-dimensional ordinary differential equation model coupling malaria and dengue transmission through two vector populations (Anopheles and Aedes), in which the two screening rates are control variables competing for a single pointwise-constrained diagnostic budget. We establish well-posedness, derive the basic and invasion reproduction numbers by the next-generation matrix method, and characterise the optimal controls via the Pontryagin Maximum Principle with the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions, so that the allocation depends explicitly on the shadow price of the budget. A forward-backward sweep solves the boundary value problem, cross-validated against a sequential quadratic Hamiltonian scheme. Calibration to 104 weeks of Kadiogo Province surveillance attains coefficients of determination on the log(Y+1) scale of 0.82 (malaria) and 0.72 (dengue), with R 0 m =1.14 and R 0 d =1.57. The optimal dynamic allocation outperforms every heuristic tested, including two that are themselves time-varying: it reduces disease burden by 24.6% relative to standard malaria-first practice at the baseline budget and by over 32% at double the budget, and outperforms malaria-first in every one of 200 parameter draws under ± 30% uncertainty. The gain comes from the two epidemics peaking months apart, which in an epidemic year follows from malaria opening the season near its endemic level while dengue starts from a small seed.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of distinguishing between malaria and dengue infections, which present similarly as undifferentiated fever, and to optimise diagnostic test allocation under budget constraints to improve case management.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A mathematical model was developed to simulate the transmission dynamics of malaria and dengue in Burkina Faso, focusing on the interaction between the two diseases and their respective vector populations (Anopheles and Aedes) over a 104-week surveillance period in Kadiogo Province.
analysis.methods: The study employed a 15-dimensional ordinary differential equation model, coupled with the Pontryagin Maximum Principle and Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions, to characterise optimal diagnostic test allocation. A forward-backward sweep method was used to solve the boundary value problem, cross-validated against a sequential quadratic Hamiltonian scheme.
analysis.main_results: The model achieved a coefficient of determination of 0.72 on the log(Y+1) scale for dengue, with an invasion reproduction number (R 0 d) of 1.57. The optimal dynamic allocation of diagnostic tests reduced disease burden by 24.6% at the baseline budget and by over 32% at double the budget, outperforming standard malaria-first practices in all 200 parameter draws under ± 30% uncertainty.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the optimal allocation strategy significantly improves disease burden reduction by leveraging the temporal separation of malaria and dengue epidemics, which allows for more efficient use of diagnostic resources.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a framework for optimising diagnostic test allocation in regions with co-circulating malaria and dengue, potentially improving case management and resource efficiency in public health settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on a mathematical model calibrated to surveillance data, which may not fully capture real-world complexities. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the model's assumptions and the limited scope of parameter uncertainty considered.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the challenge of distinguishing between malaria and dengue infections, which present similarly as undifferentiated fever, and aims to optimise diagnostic test allocation under budget constraints. A 15-dimensional ordinary differential equation model was developed to simulate the transmission dynamics of both diseases, incorporating vector populations and a constrained diagnostic budget. The model was calibrated to 104 weeks of surveillance data from Kadiogo Province, achieving a coefficient of determination of 0.72 for dengue. The optimal dynamic allocation of diagnostic tests reduced disease burden by 24.6% at the baseline budget and by over 32% at double the budget, outperforming standard malaria-first practices. The authors interpret that this improvement stems from the temporal separation of the two epidemics, allowing for more efficient resource use. The findings offer a framework for optimising diagnostic strategies in regions with co-circulating malaria and dengue, with moderate evidence strength due to model assumptions and limited parameter uncertainty analysis.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决疟疾和登革热感染在临床表现上相似(均表现为非特异性发热)的区分挑战,并在预算限制下优化诊断测试的分配,以改善病例管理。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 开发了一个数学模型,模拟布基纳法索疟疾和登革热的动态,重点关注这两种疾病及其各自的媒介种群(按蚊和伊蚊)在Kadiogo省104周期间的相互作用。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用了一个15维的常微分方程模型,结合庞特里亚金极大值原理和库什-库恩-塔克条件,以表征诊断测试的最优分配。通过前向-后向扫描方法解决了边界值问题,并通过顺序二次哈密顿方案进行了交叉验证。
elements_zh.main_results: 该模型在登革热的log(Y+1)尺度上实现了0.72的决定系数,其入侵繁殖数(R 0 d)为1.57。在基线预算下,诊断测试的最优动态分配减少了24.6%的疾病负担,在双倍预算下减少了超过32%的疾病负担,在±30%的不确定性范围内,所有200个参数抽样均优于标准的疟疾优先检测实践。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释认为,最优分配策略通过利用疟疾和登革热疫情在时间上的分离,显著提高了疾病负担的减少效果,从而实现了诊断资源的更高效利用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为在同时流行疟疾和登革热的地区优化诊断测试分配提供了框架,可能有助于改善病例管理和公共卫生资源的使用效率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究依赖于校准到监测数据的数学模型,可能无法完全反映现实世界的复杂性。由于模型的假设和考虑的参数不确定性范围有限,其证据强度中等。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of distinguishing between malaria and dengue infections, which present similarly as undifferentiated fever, and to optimise diagnostic test allocation under budget constraints to improve case management.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A mathematical model was developed to simulate the transmission dynamics of malaria and dengue in Burkina Faso, focusing on the interaction between the two diseases and their respective vector populations (Anopheles and Aedes) over a 104-week surveillance period in Kadiogo Province.
analysis_en.methods: The study employed a 15-dimensional ordinary differential equation model, coupled with the Pontryagin Maximum Principle and Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions, to characterise optimal diagnostic test allocation. A forward-backward sweep method was used to solve the boundary value problem, cross-validated against a sequential quadratic Hamiltonian scheme.
analysis_en.main_results: The model achieved a coefficient of determination of 0.72 on the log(Y+1) scale for dengue, with an invasion reproduction number (R 0 d) of 1.57. The optimal dynamic allocation of diagnostic tests reduced disease burden by 24.6% at the baseline budget and by over 32% at double the budget, outperforming standard malaria-first practices in all 200 parameter draws under ± 30% uncertainty.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the optimal allocation strategy significantly improves disease burden reduction by leveraging the temporal separation of malaria and dengue epidemics, which allows for more efficient use of diagnostic resources.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a framework for optimising diagnostic test allocation in regions with co-circulating malaria and dengue, potentially improving case management and resource efficiency in public health settings.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on a mathematical model calibrated to surveillance data, which may not fully capture real-world complexities. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the model's assumptions and the limited scope of parameter uncertainty considered.

title_zh: 通过在预算限制下优化诊断测试分配来优化疟疾和登革热病例管理。
source_body_en: In 2023 Burkina Faso faced hyperendemic Plasmodium falciparum malaria alongside the largest dengue epidemic recorded in West Africa. Both present as undifferentiated fever, and rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) are the practical means of distinguishing them at the point of care. We formulate a 15-dimensional ordinary differential equation model coupling malaria and dengue transmission through two vector populations (Anopheles and Aedes), in which the two screening rates are control variables competing for a single pointwise-constrained diagnostic budget. We establish well-posedness, derive the basic and invasion reproduction numbers by the next-generation matrix method, and characterise the optimal controls via the Pontryagin Maximum Principle with the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions, so that the allocation depends explicitly on the shadow price of the budget. A forward-backward sweep solves the boundary value problem, cross-validated against a sequential quadratic Hamiltonian scheme. Calibration to 104 weeks of Kadiogo Province surveillance attains coefficients of determination on the log(Y+1) scale of 0.82 (malaria) and 0.72 (dengue), with R 0 m =1.14 and R 0 d =1.57. The optimal dynamic allocation outperforms every heuristic tested, including two that are themselves time-varying: it reduces disease burden by 24.6% relative to standard malaria-first practice at the baseline budget and by over 32% at double the budget, and outperforms malaria-first in every one of 200 parameter draws under ± 30% uncertainty. The gain comes from the two epidemics peaking months apart, which in an epidemic year follows from malaria opening the season near its endemic level while dengue starts from a small seed.

title: Dengue in an era of hyperendemicity: clinical triage, case management, and primary care preparedness in resource-constrained settings: a narrative review
abstract: Dengue is placing increasing pressure on frontline health services as recurrent transmission, co-circulating serotypes, and expanding outbreaks generate large volumes of clinically similar febrile illnesses. Although most infections remain uncomplicated, deterioration may occur rapidly around defervescence, creating a narrow window in which clinicians must distinguish patients suitable for outpatient care from those requiring observation, stabilization, or referral. This narrative review examines dengue management as a continuous clinical pathway linking early recognition, decision-relevant testing, dynamic triage, phase-specific care, vulnerability assessment, and primary care preparedness in resource-constrained settings. The evidence indicates that diagnostic confirmation and severity prediction are related but distinct tasks: laboratory testing can support diagnosis, but safe disposition depends on repeated assessment of illness day, hemodynamic status, perfusion, urine output, fluid balance, functional decline, and evolving clinical or laboratory trends. Outpatient management should therefore be treated as an active care pathway requiring structured reassessment, explicit safety netting, and feasible return arrangements, while intravenous fluid therapy should be individualized according to disease phase, treatment response, and risk of overload. Children, pregnant and postpartum patients, older adults, people with comorbidities, and those facing transport, communication, or referral barriers, require modified thresholds for observation and escalation. Primary care readiness should be judged by the reliable performance of essential functions, including structured triage, monitoring, patient communication, stabilization, referral coordination, and surveillance-linked surge response, rather than by the nominal availability of guidelines, training, diagnostics, or equipment. abstract_zh: 登革热正对一线卫生服务施加日益增加的压力,因为反复暴发、共循环的血清型以及扩展的传播范围导致大量临床相似的发热性疾病。尽管大多数感染仍为非复杂性,但退热前后可能迅速恶化,这为临床医生区分适合门诊治疗的患者和需要观察、稳定或转诊的患者创造了狭窄的时间窗口。本叙述性综述探讨了登革热管理作为一条连续的临床路径,涵盖早期识别、决策相关检测、动态分诊、疾病阶段特定护理、脆弱性评估以及资源匮乏地区的初级卫生保健准备。证据表明,诊断确认和严重程度预测是相关但不同的任务:实验室检测可以支持诊断,但安全处置依赖于对疾病天数、血流动力学状态、灌注情况、尿量、体液平衡、功能下降以及临床或实验室趋势的重复评估。因此,门诊管理应被视为一项主动的护理路径,需要结构化的重新评估、明确的安全网措施以及可行的返程安排,而静脉输液治疗则应根据疾病阶段、免疫应答及过载风险进行个体化调整。儿童、孕妇及产后患者、老年人、有合并症的患者以及面临交通、沟通或转诊障碍的人群,需要调整观察和升级的阈值。初级卫生保健的准备应通过关键功能的可靠执行来评估,包括结构化分诊、监测、患者沟通、稳定、转诊协调以及与基因组监测相关的突发情况应对,而不是仅仅依赖于指南、培训、诊断工具或设备的名义可用性。然而,现有证据主要来自亚洲和拉丁美洲的医院研究,存在关于初级卫生保健、非洲、农村地区、脆弱系统以及人道主义环境的重大空白。因此,优先事项是将现有的临床指导转化为在常规登革热暴发和基因组监测相关暴发中均可实施并一致提供的前线护理路径。

title: The circSNX6 restricts dengue virus replication in association with PARP1 and ferroptosis
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) infection poses a persistent global health challenge with no specific antiviral therapy. Although circular RNAs (circRNAs) regulate antiviral immunity, their roles in DENV infection remain largely unexplored. Here, transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from dengue patients across disease phases and severities identified 15 circRNAs consistently dysregulated across all clinical stages, enriched in ferroptosis, glutathione metabolism, and endocytosis pathways. Among these, hsa_circ_0031607 (circSNX6) was the sole circRNA linked to all three pathways and was upregulated in both dengue patients and DENV2-infected human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs). circSNX6 overexpression suppressed DENV2 replication, whereas its knockdown enhanced viral propagation. Mechanistically, circSNX6 localized to the cytoplasm and interacted with PARP1. DENV2 infection induced partial PARP1 redistribution from nucleus to cytoplasm. circSNX6 suppressed PARP1 expression; its knockdown increased global PARylation, accompanied by enhanced NRF2 PARylation and altered TFR1 and GPX4 expression. In cultured cells, ferrostatin-1 reduced and erastin enhanced DENV2 replication; olaparib or ferrostatin-1 partially attenuated the proviral effects of circSNX6 knockdown, while erastin partially reversed the antiviral effect of circSNX6 overexpression. In mice, olaparib reduced serum and hepatic viral loads and attenuated hepatic pathology; ferrostatin-1 produced comparable effects, and erastin cotreatment partially diminished olaparib-mediated protection. Together, these results delineate the circRNA landscape across dengue disease progression and identify circSNX6 as a host factor that restricts DENV2 replication in part through suppression of the PARP1–ferroptosis axis.
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

analysis.research_question_and_background: Dengue virus (DENV) infection poses a persistent global health challenge with no specific antiviral therapy. Although circular RNAs (circRNAs) regulate antiviral immunity, their roles in DENV infection remain largely unexplored.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Here, transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from dengue patients across disease phases and severities identified 15 circRNAs consistently dysregulated across all clinical stages, enriched in ferroptosis, glutathione metabolism, and endocytosis pathways.
analysis.methods: The study used transcriptome sequencing of PBMCs from dengue patients across disease phases and severities to identify circRNAs. It also included cultured cells and mice models to assess the effects of circSNX6 on DENV2 replication and related pathways.
analysis.main_results: Among the 15 circRNAs, hsa_circ_0031607 (circSNX6) was the sole circRNA linked to all three pathways and was upregulated in both dengue patients and DENV2-infected human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs). circSNX6 overexpression suppressed DENV2 replication, whereas its knockdown enhanced viral propagation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Mechanistically, circSNX6 localized to the cytoplasm and interacted with PARP1.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings identify circSNX6 as a host factor that restricts DENV2 replication, offering potential insights into new therapeutic strategies targeting the PARP1–ferroptosis axis for dengue management.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-level evidence, and the results are based on in vitro and in vivo models, which may not fully represent human disease complexity. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of detailed clinical data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of circRNAs in dengue virus (DENV) infection, focusing on circSNX6. It identifies circSNX6 as a host factor that restricts DENV2 replication through interactions with PARP1 and modulation of the ferroptosis pathway. The research highlights potential therapeutic strategies targeting the PARP1–ferroptosis axis. However, the study is limited to abstract-level evidence and relies on in vitro and in vivo models, which may not fully capture human disease dynamics. The findings contribute to understanding the host-virus interaction in DENV infection and suggest new avenues for antiviral approaches.

title_zh: circSNX6通过与PARP1和铁死亡的关联抑制登革病毒复制
source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV) infection poses a persistent global health challenge with no specific antiviral therapy. Although circular RNAs (circRNAs) regulate antiviral immunity, their roles in DENV infection remain largely unexplored. Here, transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from dengue patients across disease phases and severities identified 15 circRNAs consistently dysregulated across all clinical stages, enriched in ferroptosis, glutathione metabolism, and endocytosis pathways. Among these, hsa_circ_0031607 (circSNX6) was the sole circRNA linked to all three pathways and was upregulated in both dengue patients and DENV2-infected human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs). circSNX6 overexpression suppressed DENV2 replication, whereas its knockdown enhanced viral propagation. Mechanistically, circSNX6 localized to the cytoplasm and interacted with PARP1. DENV2 infection induced partial PARP1 redistribution from nucleus to cytoplasm. circSNX6 suppressed PARP1 expression; its knockdown increased global PARylation, accompanied by enhanced NRF2 PARylation and altered TFR1 and GPX4 expression. In cultured cells, ferrostatin-1 reduced and erastin enhanced DENV2 replication; olaparib or ferrostatin-1 partially attenuated the proviral effects of circSNX6 knockdown, while erastin partially reversed the antiviral effect of circSNX6 overexpression. In mice, olaparib reduced serum and hepatic viral loads and attenuated hepatic pathology; ferrostatin-1 produced comparable effects, and erastin cotreatment partially diminished olaparib-mediated protection. Together, these results delineate the circRNA landscape across dengue disease progression and identify circSNX6 as a host factor that restricts DENV2 replication in part through suppression of the PARP1–ferroptosis axis.
abstract_zh: 登革病毒(DENV)感染对全球健康构成持续挑战,目前尚无特定的抗病毒药物疗法。尽管环状RNA(circRNAs)调节抗病毒药物免疫,但它们在DENV感染中的作用仍 largely unexplored。在这里,通过对登革热患者不同疾病阶段和严重程度的外周血单核细胞(PBMCs)进行转录组测序,鉴定了15个在所有临床阶段中一致失调的circRNAs,这些circRNAs富集于铁死亡、谷胱甘肽代谢和内吞作用通路。其中,hsa_circ_0031607(circSNX6)是唯一与这三个通路相关联的circRNA,并且在登革热患者和DENV2感染的人脐静脉内皮细胞(HUVECs)中均被上调。circSNX6的过表达抑制了DENV2的复制,而其敲低则增强了病毒传播。机制上,circSNX6定位于细胞质并与PARP1相互作用。DENV2感染导致PARP1部分从细胞核转移到细胞质。circSNX6抑制了PARP1的表达;其敲低增加了全局的PARylation,伴随NRF2的PARylation增强以及TFR1和GPX4表达的改变。在培养的细胞中,ferrostatin-1减少了DENV2的复制,而erastin增强了DENV2的复制;olaparib或ferrostatin-1部分减弱了circSNX6敲低的促病毒作用,而erastin部分逆转了circSNX6过表达的抗病毒作用。在小鼠中,olaparib降低了血清和肝脏中的病毒载量,并减轻了肝脏病理;ferrostatin-1产生了类似的效果,而erastin联合治疗部分抵消了olaparib介导的保护作用。综上所述,这些结果描绘了circRNA在登革热疾病进展中的图谱,并确定了circSNX6作为限制DENV2复制的宿主因子,其作用部分通过抑制PARP1–铁死亡轴实现。

title: The capsid proteins of orthoflavivirus are interchangeable for West Nile virus assembly.
abstract: ABSTRACT Orthoflavivirus virions consist of an envelope enclosing a nucleocapsid core. A critical step in orthoflavivirus assembly is the encapsidation of genomic RNA by the capsid protein to form the nucleocapsid. However, the molecular details of this process remain poorly understood, particularly whether capsid proteins bind genomic RNA through specific interactions. Here, we utilized West Nile virus (WNV) and dengue virus (DENV) as model systems to investigate heterologous genome RNA encapsidation. Employing a chimeric virus strategy, we demonstrated that the DENV-2 capsid protein can package WNV genomic RNA if two critical elements are preserved: cis -acting sequences essential for RNA synthesis and the cleavage site required for capsid maturation. Furthermore, by decoupling the WNV cis -acting elements from the capsid-coding sequence and replacing the WNV capsid protein with orthologous capsid proteins from other orthoflaviviruses, we provide direct virological evidence that orthoflavivirus capsid proteins package genomic RNAs in a non-sequence-specific manner. These findings advance our mechanistic understanding of orthoflavivirus genome packaging. IMPORTANCE The encapsidation of genomic RNA by capsid proteins as the primary event in orthoflavivirus virion assembly is not well understood in current research; particularly, whether it involves specific packaging signals remains a question. The orthoflavivirus capsid protein plays a key role in both genome replication and viral particle assembly. Our comprehensive virological analyses reveal that orthoflavivirus capsid protein shows considerable interspecies packaging flexibility while critical replication and processing elements are preserved. These insights underscore a key aspect of orthoflavivirus biology: the conserved packaging function of capsid proteins across genus members is mediated by structural interactions, rather than sequence specificity.

IMPORTANCE The encapsidation of genomic RNA by capsid proteins as the primary event in orthoflavivirus virion assembly is not well understood in current research; particularly, whether it involves specific packaging signals remains a question. The orthoflavivirus capsid protein plays a key role in both genome replication and viral particle assembly. Our comprehensive virological analyses reveal that orthoflavivirus capsid protein shows considerable interspecies packaging flexibility while critical replication and processing elements are preserved. These insights underscore a key aspect of orthoflavivirus biology: the conserved packaging function of capsid proteins across genus members is mediated by structural interactions, rather than sequence specificity.
abstract_zh: 摘要 正黏液病毒属病毒由包膜包裹的核衣壳核心组成。正黏液病毒组装的关键步骤是衣壳蛋白将基因组RNA封装成核衣壳。然而,这一过程的分子细节仍不明确,特别是衣壳蛋白是否通过特异性相互作用结合基因组RNA。在此研究中,我们利用西尼罗病毒(WNV)和登革病毒(DENV)作为模型系统,研究异源基因组 RNA的封装。通过使用嵌合病毒策略,我们证明了当保留两个关键元件时,DENV-2衣壳蛋白可以包装WNV基因组RNA:cis-作用序列,对RNA合成至关重要,以及衣壳成熟所需的切割位点。此外,通过将WNV的cis-作用元件与衣壳编码序列分离,并用其他正黏液病毒属的同源衣壳蛋白替换WNV衣壳蛋白,我们提供了直接的病毒学证据,表明正黏液病毒属的衣壳蛋白以非序列特异性方式包装基因组RNA。这些发现推进了我们对正黏液病毒属基因组包装机制的理解。重要性 当前研究对正黏液病毒属病毒颗粒组装中衣壳蛋白封装基因组RNA这一主要事件的理解尚不充分,特别是是否涉及特异性包装信号仍是一个问题。正黏液病毒属的衣壳蛋白在基因组复制和病毒颗粒组装中起关键作用。我们的全面病毒学分析表明,正黏液病毒属的衣壳蛋白在不同物种间表现出显著的包装灵活性,同时关键的复制和加工元件得以保留。这些见解突显了正黏液病毒属生物学的一个关键方面:该属成员的衣壳蛋白在包装功能上的保守性是由结构相互作用而非序列特异性所介导的。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨正黏液病毒属的衣壳蛋白是否通过特异性相互作用结合基因组RNA。正黏液病毒组装的关键步骤是衣壳蛋白将基因组RNA封装成核衣壳,但这一过程的分子细节仍不明确。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究利用西尼罗病毒(WNV)和登革病毒(DENV)作为模型系统,研究异源基因组 RNA的封装。研究重点在于DENV-2和WNV,后者作为相关实体。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究采用嵌合病毒策略,证明当保留两个关键元件时,DENV-2衣壳蛋白可以包装WNV基因组RNA:cis-作用序列,对RNA合成至关重要,以及衣壳成熟所需的切割位点。
analysis_zh.main_results: 当保留cis-作用序列和衣壳成熟所需的切割位点时,DENV-2衣壳蛋白被证明可以包装WNV基因组RNA。研究还揭示了正黏液病毒属衣壳蛋白以非序列特异性方式包装基因组RNA。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现提供了直接的病毒学证据,表明正黏液病毒属衣壳蛋白以非序列特异性方式包装基因组RNA,这种包装是由结构相互作用而非序列特异性所介导的。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些见解推进了我们对正黏液病毒属基因组包装机制的理解,这可能有助于未来关于病毒组装的研究,并可能为抗病毒药物策略的开发提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于摘要的证据,其发现通过使用嵌合病毒进行直接病毒学分析得到支持。由于摘要的范围有限,证据被认为是中等强度的。

title: Association of NS1 Antigen, IgM/IgG Antibodies with Haematological Indices and Inflammatory Markers in Suspected Dengue Cases: A Cross-sectional Study
abstract: Introduction: Dengue Virus (DENV) has been re-emerging as a major public health challenge in tropical and subtropical regions, including India, with increasing incidence, changing epidemiology, and seasonal outbreaks. Early diagnosis supported by laboratory markers is essential for effective clinical management and disease control. Aim: To evaluate the association of serological markers with haematological, biochemical and inflammatory parameters in clinically suspected cases of dengue. Materials and Methods: This cross-sectional study was conducted from March 2025 to December 2025 at Adarsh Multispecialty Hospital, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India. The study included 154 patients presenting with Acute Febrile Illness (AFI). DENV diagnosis was performed using an immunochromatographic kit for NS1 antigen and IgM and IgG antibodies from the serum sample. Haematological indices, Inflammation markers and liver function tests Serum Glutamic Pyruvic Transaminase (SGPT) and Serum Glutamic Oxaloacetic Transaminase (SGOT) were examined. Chi-square test was used for statistical analysis, and a p-value of <0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results: A total of 154 suspected Dengue Fever (DF) samples were collected, out of which 38 cases of dengue infection were confirmed. The highest positivity was seen in the age group of 21 to 30 years, 14 (36.8%), with males being more affected, making up 24 (63.2%) of the cases. The seasonal peaks happened during August and September, with 11/34 (32.4%) and 11/42 (26.2%) of cases, respectively. Testing for the NS1 antigen alone found 17/74 (23%) of infections, but combining NS1 and antibody testing raised the rate to about 20/73 (27.3%). Dengue patients showed significantly decreased platelet counts 35/38 (92.1%), White Blood Cell (WBC) counts 21/38 (55.26%), and also lymphocyte counts 20/38 (52.63%). Liver enzymes were also elevated (SGOT 161.58±372.44 U/L and SGPT 187.46±456.09 U/L). They also showed raised C-Reactive Protein (CRP) in 33/38 (86.8%) of cases and higher Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) in 23/38 (60.5%) of cases. Conclusion: Detection of the NS1 antigen with antibody testing gives more specific results. Significant increase in CRP levels and a drop in platelet levels in dengue-positive patients are early indicators of presumptive diagnosis. Integrated haematological, and inflammatory markers facilitate efficient risk stratification and enhance early dengue identification, enabling prompt clinical therapy during periods of peak transmission.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study aimed to evaluate the association of serological markers with haematological, biochemical, and inflammatory parameters in clinically suspected dengue cases. Conducted at Adarsh Multispecialty Hospital in Gujarat, India, from March to December 2025, the study included 154 patients with acute febrile illness. DENV diagnosis was performed using an immunochromatographic kit for NS1 antigen and IgM/IgG antibodies. The study provides insights into the clinical and laboratory features of dengue infection, which may inform early diagnosis and management strategies during peak transmission periods.

title: The Evolution of Dengue Virus in India
abstract: The evolution of dengue virus (DENV) is highly modulated by pathogen transmission bottlenecks and immunological pressures. These evolutionary events lead to mutations that cause antigenic changes and the replacement of DENV genotypes, which are directly correlated with epidemic magnitude and severe disease. India bears a disproportionately high dengue burden, accounting for nearly one-third of global cases, making it a persistent public health challenge. The periodic recurrence of outbreaks and cocirculation of all four serotypes pose challenges in disease control efforts. Nearly half of the country's population is seropositive for dengue, with varying seropositivity by age and geographical location. The spatiotemporal dynamics of prevalent serotypes in India are often associated with changes in transmission patterns, leading to cyclic outbreaks approximately every 2–3 years. Although multiple genotypes of serotypes have been recorded worldwide, Indian genotypes are highly diverged, with strong intermixing with neighboring countries. This review explores the mechanisms that drive DENV evolution underlying viral transmission bottlenecks, intrahost genetic diversity, and host immune responses. I also highlight the role of preexisting cross-reactive immunity and concurrent coinfections involving more than one serotype or other genetically similar arboviruses in the evolution of DENV. Finally, I outline the impact of DENV evolution on vaccine development and deployment in India.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the evolution of dengue virus (DENV) in India, specifically examining how transmission bottlenecks and immunological pressures influence its genetic changes. The central question is how these evolutionary dynamics contribute to the emergence of new genotypes and the severity of dengue disease.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis that explores the mechanisms driving DENV evolution, including viral transmission bottlenecks, intrahost genetic diversity, and host immune responses. It does not report on specific databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Dengue virus evolution in India is driven by transmission bottlenecks and immunological pressures, leading to mutations that cause antigenic changes and genotype replacement. These changes are directly correlated with epidemic magnitude and severe disease outcomes.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that the periodic recurrence of outbreaks and cocirculation of all four serotypes present challenges in disease control. Additionally, the spatiotemporal dynamics of prevalent serotypes are linked to changes in transmission patterns, but the exact mechanisms remain unclear.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need to understand the impact of DENV evolution on vaccine development and deployment in India. It also highlights the importance of monitoring seropositivity rates and transmission patterns to improve public health strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the evolution of dengue virus (DENV) in India, emphasizing the role of transmission bottlenecks and immunological pressures in driving genetic changes. It highlights how these changes lead to antigenic shifts and genotype replacement, which are associated with increased epidemic severity. The review also discusses the challenges posed by the periodic outbreaks and the cocirculation of all four DENV serotypes. It underscores the importance of understanding DENV evolution for vaccine development and public health interventions, particularly given India's high dengue burden. The review notes that while the spatiotemporal dynamics of DENV serotypes are linked to transmission patterns, the exact mechanisms remain unclear, creating a need for further research.

elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,登革病毒暴发的周期性复发以及四种血清型的共循环给疾病控制带来了挑战。此外,流行血清型的时空动态与传播模式的变化相关,但具体机制仍不清楚。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述强调了理解DENV系统发育对印度疫苗开发和部署的影响的重要性。同时,它还突出了监测血清阳性率和传播模式以改进公共卫生策略的必要性。

This review explores the mechanisms that drive DENV evolution underlying viral transmission bottlenecks, intrahost genetic diversity, and host immune responses. I also highlight the role of preexisting cross-reactive immunity and concurrent coinfections involving more than one serotype or other genetically similar arboviruses in the evolution of DENV. Finally, I outline the impact of DENV evolution on vaccine development and deployment in India.

title: Insecticide Esistance Status, Mechanism and Control Measures of Dengue Vector Aedes aegypti: A Systematic Review
abstract: Aedes aegypti is a primary vector responsible for transmitting several public health-threatening diseases, including dengue fever, urban yellow fever, chikungunya, and Zika virus. Vector control has traditionally relied heavily on various chemical insecticides; however, this prolonged and intensive use of synthetic chemicals has led to the development of insecticide resistance in mosquito populations. This review outlines the current status of resistance develops to key classes of chemical insecticides, including carbamates, organochlorines, organophosphates, and pyrethroids. Additionally, the review provides an in-depth explanation of the underlying mechanisms responsible for the resistance observed in Aedes mosquitoes in natural populations. Four main types of resistance mechanisms have been identified based on biochemical processes, including Altered target-site resistance, Metabolic resistance, Penetration resistance and Behavioral resistance. This study reveals that Aedes aegypti demonstrates the highest resistance to pyrethroids, especially permethrin and deltamethrin, yet remains comparatively susceptible to organophosphates, notably malathion and fenitrothion. Further research is necessary to address key knowledge gaps and support the development of effective alternatives to conventional insecticides. It is suggested to exploit the effectiveness of plant-based compounds, biological control agents, and sterile insect technique to control the Aedes aegypti population. J Bangladesh Agril Univ 24(3): 187–200, 2026
journal: Journal of the Bangladesh Agricultural University

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the insecticide resistance status, mechanisms, and control measures of Aedes aegypti, the primary vector of dengue virus. The central question is to evaluate the current resistance trends and their implications for vector control strategies.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of existing literature on insecticide resistance in Aedes aegypti. It includes studies on resistance mechanisms and control measures, with an emphasis on biochemical processes and practical interventions.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that Aedes aegypti has developed significant resistance to pyrethroids, particularly permethrin and deltamethrin, while remaining relatively susceptible to organophosphates such as malathion and fenitrothion. Four main resistance mechanisms are identified: Altered target-site resistance, Metabolic resistance, Penetration resistance, and Behavioral resistance.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights the need for further research to address knowledge gaps and develop effective alternatives to conventional insecticides. There is limited data on the effectiveness of newer control methods in different geographic regions and populations.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests exploring plant-based compounds, biological control agents, and the sterile insect technique as potential alternatives to conventional insecticides for controlling Aedes aegypti populations. These methods could help mitigate the growing problem of insecticide resistance.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review examines the insecticide resistance status, mechanisms, and control measures of Aedes aegypti, the primary vector of dengue virus. It highlights the increasing resistance to pyrethroids, particularly permethrin and deltamethrin, and identifies four main resistance mechanisms. The review emphasizes the need for further research and the exploration of alternative control strategies such as plant-based compounds, biological agents, and sterile insect techniques to address the growing challenge of insecticide resistance. title_zh: 登革病毒媒介埃及伊蚊的杀虫剂抗性状况、机制及控制措施:系统综述
source_body_en: Aedes aegypti is a primary vector responsible for transmitting several public health-threatening diseases, including dengue fever, urban yellow fever, chikungunya, and Zika virus. Vector control has traditionally relied heavily on various chemical insecticides; however, this prolonged and intensive use of synthetic chemicals has led to the development of insecticide resistance in mosquito populations. This review outlines the current status of resistance develops to key classes of chemical insecticides, including carbamates, organochlorines, organophosphates, and pyrethroids. Additionally, the review provides an in-depth explanation of the underlying mechanisms responsible for the resistance observed in Aedes mosquitoes in natural populations. Four main types of resistance mechanisms have been identified based on biochemical processes, including Altered target-site resistance, Metabolic resistance, Penetration resistance and Behavioral resistance. This study reveals that Aedes aegypti demonstrates the highest resistance to pyrethroids, especially permethrin and deltamethrin, yet remains comparatively susceptible to organophosphates, notably malathion and fenitrothion. Further research is necessary to address key knowledge gaps and support the development of effective alternatives to conventional insecticides. It is suggested to exploit the effectiveness of plant-based compounds, biological control agents, and sterile insect technique to control the Aedes aegypti population. title: Unveiling the antiviral mechanism of A4S7: a synthetic antimicrobial peptide targeting dengue and other mosquito-borne enveloped virus infections
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV), an enveloped mosquito-borne flavivirus, is the causative agent of dengue and prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions. Severe cases can progress to dengue hemorrhagic fever or shock syndrome, posing significant public health challenges. In the absence of specific antiviral drugs, antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) have emerged as promising therapeutic agents against DENV due to their broad-spectrum antibacterial and antiviral properties. This study investigated the synthetic AMP A4S7, which effectively inhibited DENV-2 RNA and protein expression and reduced viral progeny production at specified concentrations without exhibiting cytotoxicity in Vero cells. Time-of-addition assays indicated that A4S7 might exert antiviral effects during early stages of infection. Binding assays further demonstrated that A4S7 interfered with DENV-2 binding to cellular membrane receptors, supported by molecular docking and FOPPR analyses, which revealed a direct interaction between A4S7 and the DENV-2 envelope protein. Moreover, A4S7 displayed antiviral activity in DENV-2-infected human cell lines, including U2OS, HMC3, and IMR-32 cells. Notably, the α-helical structure of A4S7 was found to be crucial for its antiviral activity. Furthermore, combining A4S7 with late-stage inhibitors such as ivermectin or favipiravir resulted in superior antiviral efficacy compared with their respective monotherapies. Importantly, A4S7 also exhibited antiviral activity against other enveloped viruses, including Zika virus (ZIKV) and Sindbis virus (SINV), but showed no inhibitory effects against non-enveloped viruses such as enterovirus 71 (EV71) and adenovirus. These findings underscore the potential of A4S7 as a promising candidate for the treatment of dengue and other enveloped viral infections.

title_zh: 揭示A4S7的抗病毒药物机制:一种针对登革热及其他蚊媒包膜病毒感染的合成抗菌肽
source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV), an enveloped mosquito-borne flavivirus, is the causative agent of dengue and prevalent in tropical and subtropical regions. Severe cases can progress to dengue hemorrhagic fever or shock syndrome, posing significant public health challenges. In the absence of specific antiviral drugs, antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) have emerged as promising therapeutic agents against DENV due to their broad-spectrum antibacterial and antiviral properties. This study investigated the synthetic AMP A4S7, which effectively inhibited DENV-2 RNA and protein expression and reduced viral progeny production at specified concentrations without exhibiting cytotoxicity in Vero cells. Time-of-addition assays indicated that A4S7 might exert antiviral effects during early stages of infection. Binding assays further demonstrated that A4S7 interfered with DENV-2 binding to cellular membrane receptors, supported by molecular docking and FOPPR analyses, which revealed a direct interaction between A4S7 and the DENV-2 envelope protein. Moreover, A4S7 displayed antiviral activity in DENV-2-infected human cell lines, including U2OS, HMC3, and IMR-32 cells. Notably, the α-helical structure of A4S7 was found to be crucial for its antiviral activity. Furthermore, combining A4S7 with late-stage inhibitors such as ivermectin or favipiravir resulted in superior antiviral efficacy compared with their respective monotherapies. Importantly, A4S7 also exhibited antiviral activity against other enveloped viruses, including Zika virus (ZIKV) and Sindbis virus (SINV), but showed no inhibitory effects against non-enveloped viruses such as enterovirus 71 (EV71) and adenovirus. These findings underscore the potential of A4S7 as a promising candidate for the treatment of dengue and other enveloped viral infections.
abstract_zh: 登革病毒(DENV)是一种包膜蚊媒黄病毒,是登革热的病原体,并在热带和亚热带地区广泛流行。严重病例可发展为登革热出血热或休克综合征,对公共卫生构成重大挑战。在缺乏特定抗病毒药物药物的情况下,抗菌肽(AMPs)因其广谱抗菌和抗病毒药物特性,已成为对抗DENV的有前景的治疗药物。本研究探讨了合成AMP A4S7,其在特定浓度下有效抑制了DENV-2的RNA和蛋白质表达,并减少了病毒子代的产生,且在Vero细胞中未表现出细胞毒性。时间添加实验表明,A4S7可能在感染早期阶段发挥抗病毒药物作用。结合实验进一步显示,A4S7干扰了DENV-2与细胞膜受体的结合,分子对接和FOPPR分析揭示了A4S7与DENV-2包膜蛋白之间存在直接相互作用。此外,A4S7在DENV-2感染的人类细胞系(包括U2OS、HMC3和IMR-32细胞)中也表现出抗病毒药物活性。值得注意的是,A4S7的α-螺旋结构对其抗病毒药物活性至关重要。此外,将A4S7与晚期抑制剂如伊维菌素或法匹拉韦联合使用,其抗病毒药物效果优于单独使用这些药物。重要的是,A4S7还对其他包膜病毒表现出抗病毒药物活性,包括寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和辛德比斯病毒(SINV),但对非包膜病毒如肠病毒71(EV71)和腺病毒则无抑制作用。这些发现突显了A4S7作为登革热及其他包膜病毒感染治疗候选药物的潜力。

title: Assessment of the healthcare burden of dengue disease in England: a retrospective analysis (2010-2023).
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue virus is transmitted by Aedes mosquitos, which are now prevalent in destinations commonly visited by UK travellers. Increased international travel and factors including climate change contribute to the global increase in dengue cases. Here, we evaluate the healthcare burden of dengue in England. METHODS: This retrospective, descriptive, cohort study (2010-2023) utilized data collected from National Health Service healthcare records in the Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum, linked with Hospital Episode Statistics, and Office for National Statistics mortality data. The primary objective was to determine the occurrence of hospitalized dengue. Other objectives were evaluation of healthcare resource utilization and costs, characteristics of hospitalized dengue cases, and complications due to dengue. Exploratory cohorts for suspected dengue in primary care were also reported. RESULTS: Data from Clinical Practice Research Datalink-linked records for 596 patients comprising the hospitalized dengue cohort were evaluated; the incidence rate of hospitalized dengue progressively increased from 2010 until the highest in 2019 (5.8 per million person-years); rates increased in 2022 after COVID-19 lockdowns. Approximately one-third of hospitalized dengue cases were aged 18-29 years, most were White or Asian, and the most common complication was gastrointestinal conditions (gastroenteritis/colitis; 34.7 cases per 1000 person-years). Healthcare costs in the year following hospitalized dengue cases were mostly driven by inpatient admission costs; ~20% of cases had a subsequent hospital admission (~50% were dengue-related). A total of 2286 suspected cases of dengue were reported in primary care, with 1066 unconfirmed and 1220 confirmed cases. CONCLUSIONS: Increasing incidence of dengue cases in England has followed global trends. The associated healthcare burden of imported dengue suggests a need for targeted public health strategies, particularly among younger travellers. Improvements in general practitioners' reporting of suspected dengue cases and associated details of symptoms and travel history are warranted.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the healthcare burden of dengue in England from 2010 to 2023, addressing the increasing incidence of dengue cases following global trends.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective, descriptive, cohort study was conducted using data from National Health Service healthcare records, linked with Hospital Episode Statistics and Office for National Statistics mortality data, spanning from 2010 to 2023.
analysis.methods: Data were collected from the Clinical Practice Research Datalink Aurum, Hospital Episode Statistics, and Office for National Statistics mortality data, focusing on hospitalized dengue cases and suspected cases in primary care.
analysis.main_results: The incidence rate of hospitalized dengue increased progressively from 2010 to 2019, with the highest rate in 2019 (5.8 per million person-years). analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that the increasing incidence of dengue cases in England aligns with global trends, highlighting the need for targeted public health strategies, particularly among younger travellers. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估2010年至2023年间英格兰登革热对卫生保健系统的负担,应对全球趋势下登革热病例数量不断增加的发病率。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性、描述性的队列研究研究使用了国家卫生服务体系医疗记录的数据,并与医院事件统计和国家统计局死亡率数据进行了关联,时间跨度为2010年至2023年。
elements_zh.methods: 数据来源于临床实践研究数据链接 Aurum、医院事件统计和国家统计局 死亡率 数据,重点关注住院登革热病例及初级保健中的疑似病例。
elements_zh.main_results: The incidence rate of hospitalized dengue increased progressively from 2010 to 2019, with the highest rate in 2019 (5.8 per million person-years). The rate increased again in 2022 after COVID-19 lockdowns. Approximately one-third of hospitalized dengue cases were aged 18-29 years, and the most common complication was gastrointestinal conditions. Healthcare costs were primarily driven by inpatient admission costs, with ~20% of cases having a subsequent hospital admission.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究发现,英格兰登革热病例的增加趋势与全球趋势一致,突显了需要针对年轻旅行者的公共卫生策略。有必要改进全科医生对疑似登革热病例的报告以及相关症状和旅行史的详细信息。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,登革热在英格兰的输入性病例正给医疗保健系统带来日益增长的负担,凸显了公共卫生策略在管理及预防该疾病方面的重要性,尤其是在年轻旅行者群体中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到其回顾性性质以及依赖于关联的医疗记录的限制,这可能会引入偏倚。样本量足以进行趋势分析,但可能无法代表整个人群。该研究未提供因果证据,属于描述性研究。

title: Thiazolidine‐2,4‐dione and Thiazole Derivatives as Privileged Structures for Dengue Virus: A Review of Medicinal Chemistry Aspects
abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue fever is one of the greatest global health crises, with millions of infections annually and no effective antiviral therapy available. The high morbidity and mortality rate, combined with the rapid spread of the virus, highlights a critical failure in the fight against the disease. In this scenario, the search for new antiviral drugs is not only necessary, but urgent. Recently, thiazolidinedione (TZD) and thiazole derivatives have emerged as potential candidates for the treatment of dengue fever, challenging the paradigms of conventional therapies. These compounds represent a radically innovative approach by integrating direct antiviral activity—through selective inhibition of the NS2B‐NS3 protease and NS5 RNA polymerase—with the modulation of the inflammatory response, a key determinant in the progression of severe disease forms.The present study offers an in‐depth and innovative analysis of the therapeutic potential of these molecules, exploring in vitro and in silico assays and pharmacokinetic improvement strategies. The results reveal that TZDs and thiazoles have high affinity for strategic viral targets, effectively interrupting the DENV replication cycle and reducing the immunopathological effects of the infection. Unlike conventional antivirals, which fail to target a single mechanism of action, these molecules offer a multifunctional and disruptive approach, potentially redefining the treatment of dengue. By consolidating new therapeutic perspectives and providing a solid basis for future preclinical and clinical investigations, this study not only contributes to the advancement of biomedical science, but also represents a crucial milestone in the fight against one of the most neglected viruses in the world.
authors: Moacyr Jesus Barreto de Melo Rêgo

The study explores the in vitro and in silico properties of these compounds, emphasizing their ability to inhibit key viral enzymes such as NS2B-NS3 protease and NS5 RNA polymerase, as well as modulate the inflammatory response. title_zh: 噻唑烷-2,4-二酮及其噻唑衍生物作为登革病毒的特权结构:药物化学方面的综述
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Dengue fever is one of the greatest global health crises, with millions of infections annually and no effective antiviral therapy available. The high morbidity and mortality rate, combined with the rapid spread of the virus, highlights a critical failure in the fight against the disease.
